welcome_page.description:
Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and how places look when you ride a motorcycle or scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

questionnaire.title: Motorcycle and scooter – Trip experience and surroundings

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or by closing the visor
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by motorcycle)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you do when streets or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

sections.title: Motorcycle and scooter – How the trip feels

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how stressed or relaxed do you usually feel?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how often do you feel anxious or overwhelmed?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed?

options.text: Aggressive or careless drivers, riders or pedestrians
Routes that are complicated or new to me
Noise, crowds or too much going on around me
Being in a hurry or afraid of being late
Feeling alone or isolated on the way
Health problems on the way (pain, breathlessness, dizziness)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how do you feel on streets with lots of people, shops and activity?

options.text: I prefer them: I feel safer or more at ease
I like them: they make the trip nicer
It makes no difference to me
They are sometimes a bit too much for me
Crowds stress me or make it hard to get through

sections.title: Motorcycle and scooter – Effort and satisfaction

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how tired do you usually feel when you arrive?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what tires you most?

options.text: Stress (traffic, finding the way, being late, feeling unsafe)
Waiting or standing (at traffic lights, in queues)
I rarely feel tired after my trips

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how demanding is it compared with other ways you could travel?
questions.help: Think of both physical and mental effort. Other ways could be walking, driving or public transport.

options.text: I have no other way to travel

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how often do you arrive in the time you planned?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how satisfied are you overall?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what are you least happy with?

options.text: It's hard to reach or use
